assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic events.
The service directly supports medical necessity for coverage under the member's benefit plan.
The diagnoses further corroborate the clinical indication for this service.
